research_answer: StateFuzz reveals architecture-specific descriptive margin surfaces rather than a universal monotonic degradation curve, but these cohorts contain no observed failure boundary.
negative_evidence: No evaluated architecture/stress/budget cohort produced a failure probability above zero; failure boundaries must remain null.

key_patterns.pythia_historical: stable or increased normalized margin at 1792
key_patterns.zamba_periodic: strong dip at 768 followed by recovery at longer budgets

limitations: Mamba/Pythia only have 256 and 1792 historical budgets
historical cohorts use seeds 61-62 and ±16 token tolerance
model scale, training data and instruction tuning are unmatched
periodic_pattern ignores seed and is not four independent prompt texts
